items.detail: **Wednesday's August PCE**, forecast up **0.4%** on the month, and **Friday's September jobs report**, with about **100,000** jobs expected, are the week's main tests for the Fed.
items.why: Hot numbers would firm up October rate-hike bets. Soft ones would ease the pressure on yields and stock valuations.

items.detail: **Micron** reports after the close **Wednesday**, with analysts expecting revenue near **$50.8 billion**, up from $11.3 billion a year ago.
items.why: Micron is the week's AI spending test. A miss could stall the chip rally that lifted the Nasdaq last week.

items.detail: The **10-year Treasury yield** starts the week at **5.20%**, its highest since 2007, after the S&P 500 managed a 1.2% weekly gain despite it.
items.why: If yields keep rising, the tech selloff that hit midweek last week could return. A drop below 5% would help.

items.detail: **China's September PMIs** come out **Wednesday**, the last data before **Golden Week** shuts mainland markets from Thursday until October 7.
items.why: A factory rebound could revive EM demand after the tariff-free summit. A weak reading leaves Hong Kong exposed during the holiday.

items.detail: The **Nifty 50** starts a four-session week at **23,140**, with Tuesday's monthly F&O expiry and markets closed Friday for Gandhi Jayanti.
items.why: With Brent above $100 and US yields over 5%, foreign selling could push the Nifty below 23,000.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** starts the week at **2,844**. **Friday's payrolls** decide whether yields keep squeezing small caps, which carry more floating-rate debt.
items.why: A weak jobs number could pull yields down and help small caps. A strong one extends last week's underperformance.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** starts the week below **$84,000** after spot ETFs took in **$2.4 billion**, their biggest week since October 2025.
items.why: The ETF buying supports prices, but hot PCE or jobs data would lift yields and weigh on bitcoin, which pays no yield.

items.detail: **Ether**, near **$2,691**, faces **Tuesday's** client software deadline for the **Glamsterdam** upgrade, which is due to reach the Sepolia testnet on October 6.
items.why: If the deadline passes smoothly, the upgrade stays on schedule and could add to last week's $690 million of ETF inflows.

items.detail: **Solana's Alpenglow** upgrade can start switching on **Monday** once validators holding 95% of staked SOL have updated. It aims to cut finality to about 150 milliseconds.
items.why: A smooth rollout could push SOL above its $120 range top. A delay could cool the record ETF buying.

items.detail: **Spot gold** starts the week near **$4,293** after four losing sessions, and **Wednesday's PCE** is its biggest test.
items.why: Hot inflation data could push gold toward $4,245. Softer numbers could send it back toward $4,400.

crossCuttingTheme: Wednesday's PCE and Friday's payrolls decide whether the 10-year yield holds near 5.20% and October hike bets stand. Hot data would lift the dollar and hurt gold, small caps, Indian stocks and crypto.
